shopifyFacts.title: Game Gunstock für Nintendo Switch
shopifyFacts.descriptionStates: Merchant-authored Shopify product copy says the ABS item is a game accessory for Switch/Switch OLED small controllers and says it is unrelated to a real weapon. This is seller copy, not independent supplier proof.

visualChecks.observation: Shows the molded stock with two Switch-style controllers fitted into it; image text calls it a shooting-game gun handle/butt. Promotional text is visible, so image is evidence only, not a proposed replacement.

visualChecks.source: CJ exact Black variant image, same underlying asset Shopify lists for the Black variant
visualChecks.observation: Black molded accessory has a gun-stock silhouette and trigger-like opening. Isolated image does not itself establish whether the opening is mechanical or merely part of the controller holder.

assessment.supported: The SKU and exact Shopify variant align. Supplier title, declared material/use, one-piece contents and contextual image support a plastic game shooting accessory / Switch-controller holder, not a VR-controller accessory specifically.
assessment.notSupported: Do not describe it as generic VR-controller gear: supplier scope explicitly names Switch/Switch OLED small controllers. Do not claim every visual resemblance to a firearm is absent: the black shell is gun-stock shaped.
assessment.confidence: Evidence favors dedicated, nonfunctional gaming accessory rather than an actual firearm part, but not enough to assert legal or Google policy eligibility with certainty.
openQuestions: Supplier returned no technical drawing or written statement that the object has no firearm mounting or firearm compatibility; no manufacturer identity or independent certification was supplied.
The exact black image's trigger-like opening and gun-stock shape may be what triggered Google's policy classifier.
Google may treat a gun-shaped game accessory as restricted despite the intended console use; only an authorized manual item review could settle account eligibility.

factualDraftForManualReview.title: Black plastic Switch game controller accessory, supplier variant CJVR163445402BY
statements: This is a one-piece ABS game handle/accessory intended for the small controllers of Nintendo Switch / Switch OLED, per the CJ listing.
The listing specifies 7 × 4.3 × 29.7 cm and 102 g; the contextual supplier image shows Switch-style controllers fitted into the plastic holder.
The item is shaped like a gun stock for shooting games. The inspected supplier record does not describe a firearm, firing mechanism, ammunition, or firearm mounting.
factualDraftForManualReview.caveat: These are supplier-reported product facts and observed images, not an independent technical inspection. Ask for manual review of this exact offer; make no claim that the policy exception or approval is guaranteed.
